items.title: Roy Haynes — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I don’t know too much, but Steve, Weckl and them, uncanny hands and all of that stuff

ctx.x: How about all the guys who come out of the Steve Gadd school? [Dave] Weckl . . .
I don’t know too much, but Steve, Weckl and them, uncanny hands and all of that stuff, but not to me – not too much imagination.
